subtitles: Do you like amusement parks? Well, I sure do.
To amuse myself, I went twice last spring.
My most memorable moment was riding on the caterpillar.
Which is a gigantic rollercoaster high above the ground.
When I saw how high the Caterpillar rose into the bright blue sky, I knew it was for me.
After waiting in line for thirty minutes, I made it to the front, where the man measured my height to see if I was tall enough.
I gave the man my coins, asked for change, and jumped on the cart.
Tick, tick, tick... The Caterpillar climbed slowly up the tracks.
It went so high I could see the parking lot. Boy, I was scared.
I thought to myself, "There's no turning back now."
People were so scared.
They screamed as we swiftly zoomed, fast and fast and faster along the tracks
As quickly as it started, the Caterpillar came to a stop.
Unfortunately, it was time to pack the car and drive home.
That night, I dreamt of the wild ride on the Caterpillar
Taking a trip to the amusement park and riding on the Caterpillar was my most memorable moment ever!
Megan’s cat, Snowball, loved to play in the garden.
Every morning, Megan opened the back door, and Snowball dashed outside.
The little cat chased butterflies, sniffed flowers, and climbed the old oak tree.
Megan often called Snowball her “explorer” because she loved to investigate every corner of the yard.
One day, a squirrel darted across the lawn. Snowball froze.
The squirrel stopped too, holding an acorn in its tiny paws.
Megan watched from the window, curious to see what would happen.
After a long pause, Snowball jumped forward, but the squirrel was faster.
It ran up the tree and disappeared into the branches.
Snowball meowed loudly, staring after it.
A moment later, she darted back to Megan and curled up in her lap, playing with her blanket.
Megan laughed and said, “Your playfulness never ends, Snowball!”
She patted her gently and added, “Maybe next time you’ll catch that squirrel.”
Snowball purred contentedly, resting her head on Megan’s arm.
Every summer, Jake and his friends visited the lake near his grandfather’s cabin.
The water sparkled under the bright sun, and the tall trees swayed gently in the breeze.
One afternoon, Jake decided to go fishing.
He grabbed a rod, bait, and a bucket, then walked to the dock.
Sitting quietly, he cast his line into the water and waited and waited and waited.
Suddenly, the rod jerked. Jake pulled hard, and a shiny fish wriggled at the end of the line.
He shouted, “I caught one!” His friends ran over to see, cheering loudly.
Jake carefully placed the fish in the blanket-- in the bucket.
“Maybe next time, I’ll catch a bigger one,” he said with a grin.
Later that day, Jake returned to the cabin and told his grandfather about the fish.
His grandfather smiled and said, “You’ve got the makings of a great fisherman!”
Jake beamed proudly, excited to fish again tomorrow.
On a bright Saturday afternoon, Lucas went to the park with his family.
As he walked through the grass, he saw a large, colorful kite soaring high in the sky.
It was bright red with a long, yellow tail that flapped in the wind.
Lucas watched in awe as the kite danced above the trees, its tail twisting and turning with each gust of wind.
Curious, he walked closer and saw a boy standing near the edge of the field, holding the string of the kite.
“Want to give it a try?” the boy asked, smiling.
Lucas nodded eagerly, his heart racing with excitement.
He gripped the string tightly as the wind tugged, lifting the kite even higher into the air.
“Hold it steady,” the boy said, giving Lucas a few tips.
As the kite soared gracefully, Lucas heard the chirping of the birds-- of birds and the sharp "shh" of the trees swaying in the breeze.
Suddenly, a jet flew overhead with a loud "whoosh," its engines roaring like thunder.
“That was amazing!” Lucas exclaimed.
The boy laughed and said, “Come back tomorrow, and we can fly it-- we can fly it again.
We might even try a bigger kite and maybe chase a few more birds!”
